meta.name: docx
meta.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx files) or Word templates (.dotx files). Triggers include: any mention of 'Word doc', 'word document', '.docx', '.dotx', or requests to produce professional documents with formatting like tables of contents, headings, page numbers, or letterheads. Also use when extracting or reorganizing content from .docx or .dotx files, inserting or replacing images in documents, performing find-and-replace in Word files, working with tracked changes or comments, or converting content into a polished Word document. If the user asks for a 'report', 'memo', 'letter', 'template', or similar deliverable as a Word or .docx file, use this skill. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or general coding tasks unrelated to document generation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建、编辑和格式化 Word 文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码生成或处理 Word 文档。
copy.tagline_en: Create, edit, and format Word documents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate or process Word documents programmatically.

howto.what: 装上后，它能新建、读取和编辑 Word 文档（.docx/.dotx）：新建时能加目录、标题、页码等格式；读取时能提取文档正文；编辑时可做查找替换、插图、接受修订或加批注，并输出修改后的 .docx。
howto.when: 当你提到 .docx、Word 文档等词，或要求生成带格式的 Word 报告/信函/模板，或需要提取/编辑文档内容（如查找替换、插图）时触发。

say.text: 把这份项目报告做成 Word 文档，加目录和页码。
帮我把这个 .docx 的正文提取出来，总结成要点。
say.note: 会读取文档并输出摘要

say.text: 给现有合同加一条批注，并把改动标成修订。
say.note: 会返回带批注和修订的新 .docx

howto.what_en: Claude can create, read, and edit Word documents (.docx/.dotx). On create: TOC, headings, page numbers. On read: extracts text to summarize. On edit: find/replace, images, accept changes, add comments; outputs a valid .docx.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention .docx or Word docs, ask for a formatted Word deliverable (report/memo/template), or need to extract/edit document content (e.g., find/replace, images).

say_en.text: Turn this project report into a Word file with TOC and page numbers.
Extract the text from this .docx and summarize the key points.
say_en.note: Reads the file and returns a summary.

say_en.text: Add a comment to this contract and mark changes as tracked revisions.
say_en.note: Returns a .docx with comment and redlines.
